key.patternErrorMessage: A role key is lower-case: it starts with a letter and continues with letters, digits and underscores, up to 63 characters in all — `operate`, `night_shift`. A capital, a dash, a dot, a space or a leading digit is refused, and `defaults` is reserved.
key.description: The role's key, as `fleetless.yaml` and every assignment write it. Unique in the organization.

name.description: The display name, 1 to 60 characters and trimmed. Changing it changes nothing about rights.

inherits.description: The keys of the roles this one inherits from. A role holds whatever its parents hold, and theirs in turn. A key that names no role is kept as written; inheritance through it grants nothing, and the key appears under `dangling`.

users.description: App users, in every app of the organization, who hold this role.

app_defaults.description: Apps that use this role as their default role.

references.description: Places in documents that name this role, such as a `role` in a robot's `fleetless.yaml`. A rename with `update_references` rewrites them.

roles.description: The organization's roles with their counts, in the order they were created: the roles every organization starts with (`observe`, `operate` and `admin`) come first.

key.description: A key that names no role of the organization, because the role was deleted or renamed or never existed.

kind.description: What writes the key: `config` is a `role` or `access` value in a robot's `fleetless.yaml`, `app_user` an app user who holds it, `invitation` an invitation that carries it, `app_default` an app's default role, `role_inherits` another role that inherits from it, and `org_default` one of the organization's defaults.

label.description: What a person reads to find the place: the robot name (`config`), the e-mail address of the app user or of the invitee (`app_user`, `invitation`), the app name (`app_default`), the name of the inheriting role (`role_inherits`), or the access kind of an organization default (`org_default`).

path.description: Where the key is written. For `config`, the place in the YAML, such as `services.arm_home.role` or `access.rules[1].role`; for `role_inherits`, the key of the role that inherits from it, because display names are not unique; `null` for every other kind.

robot_id.description: The robot whose document holds the key (`config`); `null` for every other kind.

app_id.description: The app the user, invitation or default role belongs to (`app_user`, `invitation`, `app_default`); `null` for every other kind.

user_id.description: The app user who holds the key (`app_user`); `null` for every other kind.

document.description: Which version of the robot's document holds the key (`config`): the published one or the draft; `null` for every other kind.

new_version.description: For a published document, the version number a rename with `update_references` would give it, a copy that differs only in the key; `null` for a draft and for every place that is no document.

places.description: Every place that writes the key. It grants nothing wherever it is written; creating a role with this key makes the places count again.

dangling.description: Keys written somewhere that are no role, each with its places. Empty when nothing is out of step.
